english: 178-180. Lord Viṣṇu, the great lord, laughed and said: “All of you need not be afraid. Sadāśiva is the embodiment of auspiciousness. He is the destroyer of fear of all Devas. He will not burn (you). Hence, O clever ones, all of you must go along with me.
